title: Genetic drivers shape TREM2-dependent myeloid responses and glioblastoma progression.
publicationName: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology

snippet: Glioblastoma (GBM) is characterized by a heterogeneous, myeloid-enriched, and highly immunosuppressive microenvironment. TREM2 regulates microglial and macrophage functions, but its role in GBM remains unclear.
